mapper.select: SELECT a.accommodation_no AS acmNo, a.accommodation_name AS acmName, a.accommodation_address AS acmAddress, a.accommodation_contents AS contents, a.checkin AS checkinTime, a.checkout AS checkoutTime, a.tel AS acmTel, a.keyword_no AS keywordNo, a.business_no AS businessNo, a.category_no AS categoryNo FROM accommodation a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN keyword k ON a.keyword_no = k.keyword_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accommodation (accommodation_name, accommodation_address, tel, checkin, checkout, accommodation_contents, category_no, keyword_no, business_no ) VALUES (#{acmName}, #{acmAddress}, #{acmTel}, #{checkinTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{contents}, #{categoryNo}, #{keywordNo}, #{businessNo} )
